name: Infrared Signal Capture & Replay
description: Many building systems use IR remote controls — presentation room AV equipment, HVAC panels, entry intercoms, and some locking systems. The Flipper Zero captures and replays IR signals, allowing an operator to control building systems, disable AV equipment during a social engineering approach, or interfere with IR-controlled access components. Particularly useful in conference rooms and lobby environments.

blue.det: Difficult to detect — IR capture is passive and silent; replay may cause unexpected AV or HVAC activation.
blue.cm: Restrict IR control access to authorized personnel; use RF with rolling codes instead of IR for security-sensitive controls; monitor for unexpected AV or HVAC activation.
